fusions.name: Tidal Trample
fusions.desc: Rushes you up to 6 tiles at a target, then a spate of water rolls 4 tiles ahead of you, dealing 14 damage to everything caught in it.

fusions.name: Hoof Splash
fusions.desc: Kicks a spray of water at a target up to 6 tiles away that deals 7 damage, hitting harder the further it travels, up to 1.6 times at full reach. Holds 3 charges; each use spends one, and each kill restores one.

fusions.name: Ride the Current
fusions.desc: Increases your movement speed by 30% for 8 seconds, with +8% dodge chance.

fusions.name: Slackened Tide
fusions.desc: When your stamina runs out, you restore 4 stamina a second for 5 seconds. Once every 20 seconds.
